{"predictors": [
  {"name": "CEO Tenure", "construction": "Time since the CEO took office, measured in years.", "rationale": "Long-tenured CEOs might have more company knowledge and industry experience.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with CEOs who have longer tenure"},
  {"name": "Social Network Influence", "construction": "Number of followers on the company's official Twitter account.", "rationale": "Companies with a strong social network presence might have better reputation and customer loyalty.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with higher number of followers on Twitter"},
  {"name": "Patent Portfolio Value", "construction": "Number of patents held by the company multiplied by the average citation count per patent.", "rationale": "Companies with valuable patents might have more innovative potential.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with higher patent portfolio values"},
  {"name": "Executive Gender Diversity", "construction": "Proportion of female executives in the company.", "rationale": "Gender diversity in executive positions can lead to better decision making.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with higher executive gender diversity"},
  {"name": "Automation Adoption", "construction": "Capital expenditures on automation technologies divided by total capital expenditures.", "rationale": "Companies that adopt automation technologies might be more efficient and have higher productivity.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with higher automation adoption"},
  {"name": "Green Energy Investment", "construction": "Investments in renewable energy as a proportion of total investments.", "rationale": "Companies that invest in green energy might be more sustainable and forward-looking.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with higher green energy investment"},
  {"name": "Charitable Contributions", "construction": "Charitable contributions as a proportion of profits.", "rationale": "Companies that give more to charity might have better social responsibility and public image.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with higher charitable contributions"},
  {"name": "Employee Satisfaction", "construction": "Average rating on Glassdoor.", "rationale": "Companies with high employee satisfaction might have better employee morale and productivity.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with higher employee satisfaction"},
  {"name": "Data Security Measures", "construction": "Investment in cybersecurity as a proportion of total investment.", "rationale": "Companies that invest more in data security might be better prepared against cyber threats.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with higher data security measures"},
  {"name": "Supply Chain Efficiency", "construction": "Inventory turnover rate.", "rationale": "Companies with more efficient supply chains might have lower costs and higher profitability.", "higher_returns_for": "stocks with higher supply chain efficiency"}
]}
